text:
HTML::enable
Description
Enable the processing of HTML for this transaction.
Syntax
HTML
::
enable
HTML::enable
Enable the processing of HTML for this transaction.
Examples
when
HTTP_RESPONSE
{
if
{
$host
==
"www.f5.com"
}
{
HTML
::
enable
}
log
local0.
"host: $host"
}
